messages:
incident-bot: PAGING: elevated 5xx rate detected for /v1/generate upstream (gateway) — alert threshold breached (5m). P100 latency spike. Paging oncall.

sam (oncall): I'm on it. seeing a spike to ~18% 5xx from the gateway to runtime pool. traces show a lot of upstream reset/503s. any recent deploys?

jen (sre): I see a config commit 18m ago to envoy-route config in cluster 'gateway-prod' — added a retry policy on the canary route (weight 10) and a circuit_breakers.low_connections threshold which looks low. pulling envoy config now.

alex.k: confirming — commit 9f3c2b added: 
```
route_config: 
  - name: /v1/generate
    retry_policy:
      retry_on: 5xx,connect,reset
      num_retries: 3
    per_try_timeout_ms: 200
    weight: 10  # canary
    circuit_breakers:
      max_connections: 50
```
This will force clients to retry and the CBs will trip quickly. looks like a bad combination.

maria.p: customers are reporting timeouts too — support queue has an influx from AcmeCorp and BetaSuite. Irene, can you correlate customer impact?

irene (support): AcmeCorp reported 30% of calls failing in last 10m, mostly 504/502 gateway errors. Marking high priority and sending a customer note "We are investigating increased errors on API endpoints".

sam (oncall): Ok, mitigation plan: 1) remove retries on the canary route, 2) increase circuit breaker thresholds on the route/cluster, 3) shift traffic off the canary (weight->0), 4) restart envoy pods gracefully if config reload doesn't stabilize. Doing steps in that order. tagging dave.

dave (runtime-eng): ack. I can patch the envoy route on the control plane. preparing commands.

alex.k: quick check — we should prefer disabling retries before bumping CBs. retries cause amplification when upstream is overloaded. If we remove retries the error rate should drop.

ops-bot: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/envoy-routing-5xx (recommended: disable retries -> increase CB -> drain instances)

jen (sre): Running a dry patch to set num_retries: 0 on the canary route. command: 
```bash
kubectl patch configmap envoy-route-prod -p '{"data":{"route.yaml":"(edit)"}}' --type=merge
```
Applying now.

alex.k: while that goes, I'm tailing envoy logs: lots of `upstream reset` and `no healthy upstream` messages. sample: 
```
[2026-03-15T15:12:02Z] envoy error upstream reset: code=ECONNRESET, upstream: runtime-89, downstream: gateway
[2026-03-15T15:12:03Z] cluster runtime-89: no healthy endpoints
```

maria.p: after retries disabled (t+2m) we see 5xx drop from 18% -> 9% but still elevated. customers still impacted.

sam (oncall): Next, bump circuit breaker max_connections to 500 on that route cluster and set max_pending_requests higher. dave, can you patch cluster settings now?

dave (runtime-eng): patching cluster cb: 
```yaml
circuit_breakers:
  default:
    max_connections: 500
    max_pending_requests: 1000
```
Applied and pushing config.

ops-bot: Config pushed to envoy-control-plane; rolling restart of gateway-proxy pods scheduled with graceful timeout 30s.

jen (sre): After bumping CBs and restart, 5xx fell to ~1.2% within 3 minutes. tailing metrics: request latency returned to baseline for most customers. AcmeCorp still reports a small fraction of failures (<5%).

irene (support): Sent update to AcmeCorp and BetaSuite: "Mitigation in progress, issue largely mitigated; final confirmation pending."

alex.k: root cause notes so far: canary route had aggressive retries + low CBs. under load, retries multiplied traffic and caused connection exhaustion, which led to upstream resets and 5xxs. The initial config change was unintended to be so aggressive for prod.

maria.p: any followups we should do before closing? do a rollback of that route change from the commit and run a postmortem. assign to eng-runtime and SRE.

sam (oncall): I'm handing this to jen and dave for post-incident: confirm stable for 30m, revert the route change in git (PR to revert 9f3c2b), add CI checks for retry+cb combos, update runbook. Leaving channel but will rejoin on major regressions.

jen (sre): creating incident ticket INC-2026-045 and linking commits and logs. adding followups: 1) revert canary retry policy; 2) add alert for retry amplification detection; 3) update runbook with example CB thresholds.

dave (runtime-eng): filed PR to revert the route change: https://repo.internal/infra/PR/842 (link). Also adding a quick validator in control plane to reject num_retries>0 when circuit_breakers.max_connections < 200.

irene (support): Notifying customers of resolution and next steps.

ops-bot: Incident status: mitigated — partial customer impact remains (<5%) being validated. Oncall handoff to SRE and runtime-eng for postmortem and followups.

sam (oncall): Thanks team. good catch on the config combo. closing my paging. :thanks:
